note: Judged 2026-09-30 (rfc/full/rfc2865.txt:1693-1696, Section 5.6). Forbidden: honouring an Access-Accept whose Service-Type the NAS does not implement or does not know. On the L2TP LNS, TestRFC2865UnknownOrUnsupportedServiceTypeIsARejection drives both halves of 'unknown or unsupported': Login-User 1 and Callback-Framed-User 4 (defined, not implemented) and 65535 (undefined), each alone in the Accept, and fails if the session comes up; the producer is doRADIUS calling radius.AcceptedServiceType(resp, ServiceTypeFramed) and answering respond(false). TestRFC2865SupportedServiceTypeIsHonored is the conforming input (Framed-User) and fails if a supported Service-Type is refused, ruling out a check that rejects every Accept. Buffers isolated: only Service-Type varies. Records: positive against AcceptedServiceType, negative against doRADIUS, both observed red (panic breaks, which prove reachability; the discriminating assertion is the per-value accept flag).
